title: India's tigers, 1,411 to 3,682
caption:
From 1,411 to 3,682: the tiger estimate India's camera traps produced.

The 2022 figure is an average within a statistical range of 3,167–3,925 tigers.

Source: NTCA & WII 'Status of Tigers, Co-predators and Prey in India 2022'; IUCN Red List 2022. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
